{{Top|leg}}
'''SV-72''' was an [[SV-class]] supervisor [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that was constructed on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Uffel]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. In circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], the rogue droid [[LN-73]] sabotaged a droid production line on Uffel, and SV-72 was among a group of SV-class droids that were dispatched to oversee repairs to the damaged assembly line.
